companyDescription: Oncology biotech · REVTORPYK (gedatolisib) — first FDA-approved pan-PI3K/mTOR inhibitor for HR+/HER2-/PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer (approved Jul 14, 2026) · Commercial launch guided to late Q3 2026 · PIK3CA-mutant label-expansion sNDA targeted Q3 2026
priceNote: Approved Jul 14, 2026 — 3 days ahead of the Jul 17 PDUFA date — but the stock round-tripped: a +7% approval-day pop was erased by a -15% to -17.6% single-session slide when management guided commercial launch to "late Q3 2026" instead of sooner. Now roughly flat vs the pre-approval $90 screen price and down ~42% from the May 2026 all-time high of $151.02
summary: Celcuity's gedatolisib (branded REVTORPYK) won FDA approval on July 14, 2026 for HR+/HER2-/PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer, becoming the company's first commercial product — the binary regulatory catalyst that anchored the original thesis has resolved cleanly. But the stock round-tripped violently: a same-day +7% pop was erased by a -15% to -17.6% slide when management guided commercial launch to "late Q3 2026" (delayed vs prior expectations, citing drug-supply readiness), which also triggered active securities-fraud investigations by multiple law firms (no lawsuit filed yet). With Q2 earnings due Aug 6, 2026 and a PIK3CA-mutant sNDA targeted for Q3 2026 to expand the label, the thesis has shifted from "will it get approved" to "can it execute a clean commercial launch without further stumbles." Still a ค่าขนม binary — size 2-3% max — but the swing factor is now execution and litigation overhang, not regulatory risk.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: First quarterly print since the Jul 14 approval. Investors want commentary on Q3 launch readiness, drug supply timeline, payer/formulary access progress, and cash runway following the $500M convertible note raise.

catalysts.name: Commercial Launch — REVTORPYK (WT Indication)
catalysts.description: Management now guides U.S. commercial launch to late Q3 2026 (delayed vs earlier expectations) to ensure adequate product supply. This guidance shift already cost the stock ~15-18% in one session on Jul 15 — a clean, on-time launch is now the key re-rate trigger.

catalysts.name: PIK3CA-Mutant Cohort — sNDA Filing
catalysts.description: Celcuity plans to submit a supplemental NDA in Q3 2026 for the PIK3CA-mutant population, based on VIKTORIA-1 mutant-cohort data (PFS HR 0.50 vs alpelisib + fulvestrant). This is the larger addressable population beyond the WT-only label just approved; regulatory decision expected ~2027.

catalysts.name: VIKTORIA-2 — First-Line Expansion Trial
catalysts.description: Phase 3 trial (n~1,180) evaluating gedatolisib + CDK4/6 inhibitor + fulvestrant as first-line treatment for endocrine-resistant HR+/HER2- ABC. Long-dated pipeline optionality beyond the two indications already in motion.

risks: Launch-execution risk has replaced regulatory risk — management already missed once on timeline (guided "late Q3 2026" instead of sooner), triggering a -15% to -17.6% single-day drop on Jul 15, 2026 despite a clean FDA approval

Active securities-fraud investigations from multiple law firms (Kirby McInerney, Pomerantz, Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, Schall Brown & Schwartz) into whether Celcuity misled investors about launch readiness ahead of the Jul 14 approval — no lawsuit filed yet, but a real overhang into Q3

Heavy new debt load — $500M (upsized, ~$557M net proceeds) 0.25% convertible senior notes due 2032 layered onto the balance sheet mid-2026 to fund commercialization; dilution risk if notes convert, refinancing risk if launch underperforms
PIK3CA-mutant label expansion — the larger addressable population — is not yet filed; sNDA targeted Q3 2026 with a ~2027 regulatory decision, and today's price already assumes this succeeds
Competitive landscape unchanged — Novartis' alpelisib (Piqray) and AstraZeneca's capivasertib (Truqap) remain entrenched in the same PIK3CA-pathway prescriber base REVTORPYK must win share from
Analyst commentary flags tolerability/label concerns that could slow physician adoption speed even once launch begins

Delayed from earlier expectations — company cites need for adequate drug supply

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29, 2026 with 3 hawkish dissents favoring a hike — rate-hike tail risk into year-end hasn't gone away, but CELC's own approval-and-launch news flow dominates the stock's direction far more than Fed policy.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE still 3.3% YoY, well above the 2% target. Oncology drug pricing is largely insulated from near-term CPI prints; payer/formulary negotiation and launch execution matter more.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: LOW direct Fed impact on CELC's launch-execution catalyst. The hawkish-Fed backdrop compresses high-multiple biotech valuations broadly, but a clean Q3 launch plus a strong Aug 6 print would likely override sector headwinds; a second guidance disappointment would not get the benefit of the doubt.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk is LOW for CELC specifically — the regulatory binary has already resolved and the next catalysts (Aug 6 earnings, Q3 launch) are company-specific execution events. Sector-wide biotech multiple compression is a secondary headwind, not the driver of CELC's price action.

entryStrategy.verdict: ค่าขนม SPECULATIVE — the Jul 17 PDUFA binary already resolved (approved Jul 14), but the stock round-tripped on delayed Q3 launch guidance + a fraud-investigation overhang. Aug 6 Q2 earnings is the next tell. Base ~$110 (+25%) on steady launch execution, Bull ~$145 (+65%) toward analyst consensus, Moon ~$189 (+115%) on mutant-label progress + a clean beat. Size 2-3% max — the risk driver has moved from regulatory to execution/litigation, not away.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Post-approval, CELC has already booked both directions in real time — a same-day +7% pop on the Jul 14 approval headline, erased by a -15% to -17.6% slide the next day when management guided commercial launch to "late Q3 2026" instead of sooner. Into the Aug 6 earnings print and the Q3 launch window, expect continued headline sensitivity rather than a steady pre-event drift.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Ongoing — Aug 6 earnings is the next scheduled data point; the launch itself is the Q3 event
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: +7% (approval day) / -15% to -17.6% (guidance day) — already realized, not still to come

postWin.note: Reference case: Travere's Filspari FSGS approval (Apr 2026) rose +34% day-1, extending to +46% over 30 days as launch execution matched or beat expectations — the playbook CELC needs to replicate with its own Q3 launch to re-rate back toward the ~$163 analyst consensus.

postLose.note: CELC's own Jul 15, 2026 reaction is the direct precedent: shares fell ~15-17.6% in a single session purely on a delayed launch timeline (late Q3 vs expected sooner), even with a clean FDA approval already in hand — proof this stock punishes execution/timeline slips as hard as clinical failures.

spotSizing.reason: 3% max — the regulatory binary has resolved (approved), but the stock is now trading on commercial-execution risk, active securities-fraud investigations (unfiled, but a real overhang), and a Q3 launch timeline that already disappointed once. Not a clean de-risked story yet.

comparableCases.note: The most directly relevant precedent for the Aug 6 / Q3 launch catalyst is CELC's own recent history: +7% on the approval headline, then -15% to -17.6% the next session purely on a delayed launch timeline. This stock has already shown it will punish execution guidance as hard as a clinical miss.

th.summary: Gedatolisib ของ Celcuity (แบรนด์ REVTORPYK) ได้ FDA approve เมื่อ 14 ก.ค. 2026 สำหรับ HR+/HER2-/PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer เป็นสินค้าแรกของบริษัท — binary catalyst เดิมจบไปแล้ว แต่หุ้น round-trip แรงมาก: pop +7% วัน approve แต่ร่วง -15% ถึง -17.6% วันถัดมาเพราะบริษัท guide launch เป็น "late Q3 2026" ช้ากว่าที่คาด จนเกิด securities-fraud investigation จากหลายสำนักกฎหมาย (ยังไม่มีคดีฟ้องจริง) ตอนนี้มี Q2 earnings 6 ส.ค. 2026 และแผนยื่น sNDA สำหรับ PIK3CA-mutant cohort ใน Q3 2026 เพื่อขยาย label thesis เปลี่ยนจาก "จะ approve ไหม" เป็น "จะ launch ได้เรียบร้อยไหม" ยังเป็น ค่าขนม binary sizing 2-3% max แต่ความเสี่ยงย้ายจาก regulatory ไปเป็น execution + คดีความ
th.priceNote: Approve 14 ก.ค. 2026 — ก่อน PDUFA 17 ก.ค. — แต่หุ้น round-trip: pop +7% วัน approve ถูกลบด้วยการร่วง -15% ถึง -17.6% วันถัดมาเพราะ guide launch เป็น "late Q3 2026" ตอนนี้ราคาใกล้เคียงกับก่อน approve ที่ $90 และต่ำกว่า all-time high $151.02 (พ.ค. 2026) ประมาณ 42%
